description: A hand holds an early iPhone-style phone showing a grid of emoji (smileys, hearts, sun, cat faces, cherry blossom) in a dark Tokyo alley at night. Paper lanterns hang on the left; a JR sign reading 東京駅 and 'Tokyo Station' is behind, and a FamilyMart storefront sign is on the right. Oil-paint style, edge to edge, no frame, nothing violent.
reason: Legible lettering is painted in: the JR sign reads 東京駅 / 'Tokyo Station' and the storefront reads 'FamilyMart'. Repaint the street with blurred, unreadable signs and no words.
